questions.q: What happens when the model is down?
questions.a: breaker and fallback exist (platform/gateway.py); v1.0 composes neither, so it has the SDK's 2 retries, a 600s read timeout on each, and then an error

questions.q: What happens when a tool is wrong?
questions.a: a budget of steps, seconds and tokens; a failed or hung tool becomes a result the model reads

questions.q: What does it do when it does not know?
questions.a: refuses; scored on 20 unanswerable cases by one detector, shared with the suite

questions.q: Where does state live, and what if it is lost?
questions.a: index and warehouse on disk, read-only; the cache in one process's memory, and lost with it

questions.q: How is it evaluated, and how often?
questions.a: 24 cases on every pull request, all 120 weekly
the cache is keyed by tenant; the warehouse has 0 tenant columns and the index none

questions.q: What does one request cost, and who watches it?
questions.a: every model call priced on its trace span; the alert on the total is Chapter 23's, outside v1.0

questions.q: How does a changed document reach the index?
questions.a: 0 incremental paths: the index is rebuilt whole
